limitations: Primitive spinful CAR, Hubbard t/U, tetrahedral geometry, ions, permittivity and charge are inputs, not an electron construction or parameter closure.

Finite exact consumer has one correlated four-site molecule (three independent current loops), two common-q transverse standing-wave coordinates and a literal Dirichlet finite-difference field regulator; not an oscillator Fock cutoff.
Exact means all retained matter and field states, not a converged continuum or infinite-system photon. Field-wall contrast can defeat a photon claim.

The extensive microscopic law repeats the same neutral molecules at fixed density and retains a spatial transverse field and longitudinal Gauss law. The cluster closure neglects connected intercell longitudinal correlations and uses the finite-cell periodic Gauss kernel as its impurity boundary approximation.

Bulk continuation is a self-consistent Gaussian Debye-Waller plus full correlated cluster-RPA closure. It is not exact all N, a conserving all-vertex approximation, or proof of a nonlinear stable massless phase.
The explicit 3D fluctuation quadrature has 26 nonzero midpoint cells, physical UV cube and omitted central IR voxel; no quadrature-convergence or thermodynamic-limit claim.
The extensive response phase average restores both real quadratures of each common 3D q; it is not an asserted exact equality to the finite single sine-quadrature consumer.
No borrowed charged G, free Dirac sea, fitted speed, supplied Maxwell magnetic stiffness, or oscillator restoration is used.
